result.stdout:
Usage: fb-dl [URL] [--output FOLDER] [--quality best|hd|sd] [--resume] [--connections N] [--retries N]
  -o, --output FOLDER  Save videos here (default: ~/Downloads).
      --retries N      Retry temporary request failures 0-10 times (default: 2).
      --quality Q      Choose best, hd, or sd without prompting.
      --resume         Keep and verify completed chunks after interruption.
      --connections N  Concurrent connections 1-8 (default: 4; large videos).
  -h, --help           Show this help.
Omit URL for interactive mode. Choose SD or HD when prompted.
Ctrl+C cancels. Existing downloads are never overwritten.
